name: Two Swans
source:
Two Swans is a body horror visual novel about the atrophy of unexamined identity that was made for a 7-Day Game Jam. All assets were created by human hands within the window of 7/25/26 - 8/2/26.

A struggling couple go on a romantic camping trip to rekindle things but are swallowed by a fog that hides menacing monsters.

As years pass and habits remain unexamined, the person you are isn’t the person you stay. What happens when you don’t recognize yourself anymore?
translation:
《双天鹅》是一部为7日Game Jam创作的肉体恐怖视觉小说，探讨未经审视的自我认同如何日渐萎缩凋零。游戏全部素材均于2026年7月25日—8月2日期间由人工亲手绘制制作完成。

一对感情陷入危机的情侣踏上浪漫露营之旅，试图重燃昔日爱火，却被一片潜藏着骇人怪物的浓雾彻底吞噬。

岁月流逝，积习从未被审视——曾经的你，终究不会永远停留在原处。当你再也认不出镜中的自己时，将会发生什么？
